description: SEC debt maturity ladder — Debt maturity ladder for a US-listed company from SEC XBRL filings: principal due in each of the next 5 years and after, versus cash, short-term investments, operating cash flow and interest expense. Returns coverage ratios, % due within 2 and 5 years, peak year, flags and a verdict (WELL COVERED / MANAGEABLE / MATURITY WALL / REFINANCING NEEDED / NO LADDER DISCLOSED). Params: ticker= or cik=. Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
